news.title:
Gravita India boosts lead recycling capacity at Phagi by 40,500 MTPA.
Total capacity reaches 75,819 MTPA, indicating operational growth.

India's push for recycling and EPR norms is boosting demand for B2B-grade rPET, creating growth opportunities for Ganesha Ecosphere and Gravita India.
Ganesha Ecosphere's expansions aim for FY27 growth, while Gravita India targets a 20-25% volume CAGR, leveraging global recycling trends and EPR mandates.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹52.02 (vs ₹45.11 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹52.02 (up from ₹45.11 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹43.4b (up 12% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹3.79b (up 21% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 8.7% (up from 8.1% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 32% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Metals and Mining industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 20% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 46% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Gravita India Limited (NSEI:GRAVITA) entered into a binding term sheet to acquire Rashtriya Metal Industries Ltd. from the existing shareholders for INR 5.7 billion.
news.body:
Gravita India Limited (NSEI:GRAVITA) entered into a binding term sheet to acquire Rashtriya Metal Industries Ltd. from the existing shareholders for INR 5.7 billion on February 9, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 5.65 billion will be paid by Gravita India Limited. Following the acquisition, Rashtriya Metal Industries Ltd becoming a subsidiary of Gravita India Limited.

As of March 31, 2025, Rashtriya Metal Industries had INR 9.1 billion in revenue, INR 600 million in EBITDA, INR 5.58 billion in total assets and INR 3 billion in total common equity.
